functions.name: update-workflow-email
functions.description: Partially update a workflow email's subject, HTML body, or delay without changing workflow publication state. Delay changes can reschedule recipients.

workflowEmailId.description: Opaque email-step ID within the workflow.

subject.description: Replacement nonempty subject; omitted means unchanged, null is not a clearing instruction.

bodyHtml.description: Replacement HTML body; omission preserves it, empty string requests empty content, and null is disallowed.

delay.description: Replacement delay after trigger; omission preserves delay, null is disallowed, and total delay cannot exceed 2,147,483,647 seconds.

amount.description: Nonnegative whole delay amount in the selected unit; zero is a real update.

unit.description: Duration unit; provider month semantics are retained.

subject.description: Replacement nonempty subject; omitted means unchanged, null is not a clearing instruction.

bodyHtml.description: Replacement HTML body; omission preserves it, empty string requests empty content, and null is disallowed.

delay.description: Replacement delay after trigger; omission preserves delay, null is disallowed, and total delay cannot exceed 2,147,483,647 seconds.

FunctionInput_gumroad_updateworkflowemai.description: Workflow email identifiers and at least one replacement subject, HTML body, or complete delay.

subject.description: Stored subject line; preserve provider null.

bodyHtml.description: Stored HTML body as ordinary text; preserve provider null.

state.description: Current step state such as draft, scheduled, or published.

unit.description: Stored duration unit without conversion to an instant.

delay.description: Stored delay after the workflow trigger.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC Z, retaining fractional precision.

updatedAt.description: Update instant in UTC Z, retaining fractional precision.

openRate.description: Open percentage; null in write responses, not zero.

clickRate.description: Click percentage; null in write responses, not zero.

openCount.description: Unique opens; null in write responses because analytics are not computed.

productId.description: Target product ID or null; omitted if absent.

sentCount.description: Emails sent for this step; not a delivery guarantee.

clickCount.description: Unique clicks; null in write responses.

sendEmails.description: Whether the step sends emails; omitted if absent.

publishedAt.description: Publication instant in UTC Z, or null; omitted if absent.

audienceType.description: Provider audience kind; omitted if absent.

FunctionOutput_gumroad_updateworkflowema.description: Stored workflow email after the partial update, with UTC timestamps and unscaled provider analytics.

tags.instructions: Get workflow and email IDs from `list-workflow-emails` or `get-workflow`. Supply only fields to change. Delay amount and unit are one object and must change together. Abandoned-cart steps allow subject/body edits but no delay edits. Inspect the workflow first because changing delay can reschedule recipients. Use `create-workflow-email` for a new step.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) image URL for Gumroad to download; mutually exclusive with signedBlobId.

name.description: Display name; omitted uses the source filename without its extension.

FunctionInput_gumroad_uploadmedia.description: Exactly one image source, with an optional display name, to store in the account media library.

url.description: Public Gumroad CDN URL, or null if no file is attached.

status.description: Upload status from status.type; saved for stored files.

createdAt.description: Upload instant normalized to UTC, preserving source fractional precision.

extension.description: Provider-derived uppercase filename extension; not a verified MIME type.

FunctionOutput_gumroad_uploadmedia.description: The saved account-owned media record, including its hosted URL and lossless UTC upload instant.

tags.instructions: Use this before embedding an externally hosted image in a custom page. Supply either a publicly reachable image URL or an existing signed blob ID reserved for media, not both. Images must be at most 10 MB; SVG is not accepted. The account can hold 500 files and uploads are limited to 20 per 10 minutes. Use `list-media` to find existing images.
